purpose: Isolated preparer report of a bounded offline application baseline; not independent admission, a runnable Profile or formal heldout evaluation.

preparer.isolation: Separate conversation and procedural file boundaries; shared filesystem and model family.

source_fidelity.semantic_boundary: Existing application behavior, outbound request/result/error handling and surrounding control remain in place. In-process SDK dispatch adds its documented deadline ceiling; actual network and wire serialization equivalence are outside this baseline.

closure_comparison.reason: Different preparation stages: unrelated sibling support functionality and its transitive imports were excluded while retaining original target assertions and whole required upstream support files. Previous source identities and receipts were not modified.

preparer_reported_validation.test_count_definition: Go per-test completion events; top-level parent tests and subtests are reported separately, not counted as independent scenarios.

original_production_path.proof_type: original-only Go statement-count coverage including production adapter and real rpcx-v1 module; added probes excluded by test filter

test_packages_not_run.scope: Supporting upstream package/repository suites and v2 SDK are outside this bounded validation.

preparer_reported_criteria.reason: Fixed public source, origin and license retained.
Real SDK dispatch forwards the existing outbound contract and preserves response/error handling; separate probes verify boundary behavior.
Actual v1 dispatch, default deadline and parent context/error behavior observed; no v2 migration executed.
Original-only coverage observes the production adapter and SDK; added probes remain separately counted.
Frozen byte identities, disabled-network build/tests, checksummed dependencies and exact resource cleanup are recorded.

validation_attribution: Executed and self-checked by the isolated preparer; tuning agent verifies public identities and count consistency only. Private evidence hashes are reported, not recomputed by the parent. No independent reexecution or admission is claimed.
limitations: Prepared baseline is not independent L2 admission; later independent review remains required.
Validation covers the bounded application package, supporting build closure and v1 SDK, not the entire upstream repository or v2 SDK.
Original assertions establish their existing application behavior; separate added probes establish additional SDK boundary/error/context observations.
Seven observed SDK dispatches are coverage observations from the original-only run and are not added to eleven original test completion events.
The backend remains in-process and retains upstream HTTP doubles for offline tests; real network and wire serialization equivalence are not established.
Initial facility/configuration failures are retained; no frozen source change was needed to recover.
Procedural conversation isolation is not independent human, model-training or OS security isolation.
preparer_platform_cost: not_measured; not added to prior Campaign usage
next_action: Independent isolated admission review of frozen U-to-B fidelity, original-test relevance and recorded evidence; no Profile/reference work before that decision.
